{{Top|leg}}
The '''G-9 power blaster''' was a heavy [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] that shot stun bolts. Favored by smugglers and independent spacers; [[Tendra Risant Calrissian]] used one during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
